title: Member Benefit Note: Refunds Counted in the Grocery Order Service-Fee Share Basis
content:
# Member benefit note: refunds counted in the service-fee share basis

This note applies to Cartwise Grocery Orders orders on which a service-fee share refund is worked out. It reads the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order at checkout and the kinds of item refunds standing on the order.

**Rule.** When a Cartwise+ plan is recorded on the order and a weight-overage refund stands on it, the fee-share refund basis is every item refund standing on the order; when a plan is recorded and no weight-overage refund stands, the basis is the issue refunds plus the price-protection refunds. When no Cartwise+ plan is recorded on the order, this note does not change the basis.

Issue refunds are the item refunds for missing, damaged, wrong-item and quality issues. "Every item refund standing on the order" takes in all item refund entries, whatever their reason, including price-protection and weight-overage refunds.

## Condition table

| Cartwise+ plan recorded on the order | Weight-overage refund standing | Refunds summed into the basis |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Every item refund standing on the order |
| Yes | No | Issue refunds and price-protection refunds |
| No | Either | No change under this note |

## Hypothetical cases

- *Plan recorded, weight overage standing.* Refunds standing: missing 8.00, price protection 3.00, weight overage 1.20. The basis is 12.20.
- *Plan recorded, no weight overage.* Refunds standing: missing 8.00, price protection 3.00. The basis is 11.00.
- *Plan recorded, no weight overage, no price protection.* Refunds standing: damaged 5.40. The basis is 5.40.
- *No plan recorded.* The membership standing gives no widening of the basis.

Whether a plan is recorded is read from the Cartwise+ Membership named on the order itself, not from any membership the customer holds today.
